messages.en: The first music show is over~~~
From now on, sleep will disappear,
but it's still so much fun.
What hairstyle should I do tomorrow?
This is what I did today,
but I'm still thinking about it.
Today I took a really amazing nap in the waiting room.
I slept so deeply that I probably wouldn't have noticed even if someone carried me away.
Also, the image I was going for today was kind of...
A cat? Meow? Rawr?
That kind of vibe.
But when I monitored myself, everyone was saying,
"She's cute~" "She's a circle~" "She's a Coco Ball~"
So...
Why did I end up like this...?
I even dramatically winged my eyeliner upward.
Next time take it all the way to your temples.
I should just keep drawing it up until it meets in the middle of my forehead.
Tomorrow maybe something elegant? Innocent?
Sexy? Somewhere around there.
How can innocent and sexy coexist?
I'll make it happen.
Who's coming tomorrow?
Among the people who come,
"I'm trapped in Jeong Hayeon and can't get out!!!!!!!"
The first person to shout that,
will get a nice gift.
Oh, personal comments aren't allowed?
That's a shame. ㅎ

messages.ko: 낼 미팬 아냐? 미팬 때 하라고 해
messages.en: Isn't tomorrow the mini fan meeting? Do it there.
Oh right, if I do it at the mini fan meeting,
I'll seriously give a prize.
Look forward to it.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹ

messages.ko: 아니 정하연 작년 생일때도 축하영상 미션 주더니만 계속 미션주네 육간단들한테 ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
messages.en: Hayeon, you gave missions during your birthday last year too. You're always assigning missions to Hexagon ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
ㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㄹㅋㅋㅋ
But even when I tell you to do them, you don't!!!
You all acted like you would, so I got excited,
but not a single person uploaded anything!!!!!
Because you never give prizes.

messages.ko: 미션을 완수한사람이 없으니까 줄 수 없었지
messages.en: I couldn't give a prize because nobody completed the mission.
ㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㅎㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
I think I've gotten pretty good at talking lately.
My vocabulary has improved.
I was trying to charm y/n, and ended up improving my vocabulary instead. ㅎ

messages.ko: 막 다른 사람도 꼬시는 거 아니야???
messages.en: You're not charming other people too, are you???
Even if other people accidentally end up charmed,
my target is
only y/n.
Believe me~
I want to write an autobiography someday too.
But I think everyone would say it's boring.
Because from the first page to the last,
it would only be about y/n.
ㅎ
Then it wouldn't be Jeong Hayeon's autobiography...
Why? What if my life is you?
But one thing is certain.
My life changed a lot before and after meeting y/n.
It changed a lot.
For the better.
Then it wouldn't be Jeong Hayeon's autobiography...
No. Depending on what kind of people Hexagon are,
and depending on what they say to me,
my feelings would have changed too.
But honestly,
I'm really happy that I met y/n.
I truly mean that.
Suddenly it got all serious~
But I hope

messages.ko: Y/n가 이쁘고 좋은말들이랑 행복이랑 사랑이 막 흘러넘쳐서 남은 사랑을 나한테 줬으면 좋겠어
messages.en: y/n is overflowing with beautiful words, happiness, and love, and gives the extra love left over to me.
Though if I'm being greedy,

messages.ko: 그 흘러넘치는 사랑이 내가 준 사랑이였으면 좋겠네
messages.en: I hope that overflowing love came from the love that I gave you.
Let's all be happy together~
Sorry I could only stop by for a little while.
I'm going to wash up and head to the salon now.
Tomorrow I'll do my best to look pretty~
Watch carefully.
ㅎㅎ I'll only look at the good comments too.
Bad comments don't bother me at all. 😂
I love you~~~
Haranghae 😍😍
